info.title: Heatwave Early Warning API
info.description: Predictions with SHAP explanations, weather, alerts and analytics.

get.description: Liveness only: the process is up. Readiness (model, data) is /api/v1/health/ready.

post.description: Score a region's conditions for today or the next 1-3 days, with SHAP factors.

get.description: The most recent stored prediction, without recomputing (what the dashboard reads).
Conditions for one region, or for every monitored region when `region_id` is omitted.

post.description: Create a DRAFT, or issue immediately with `status: ISSUED`. Replays are idempotent.

patch.description: Edit a DRAFT/READY alert, or move it to READY / ISSUED (`status`).

get.description: Audit trail: every dispatch attempt for this alert (protected: lists recipients).
Published public advisories (the in_app channels). Polled by the portal and boards.
Readiness: model loaded (guaranteed by startup) and weather data present and fresh.

AdvisoryOut.title: AdvisoryOut
AdvisoryOut.description: A published public advisory: what the portal and display boards show (Part 09).

client_request_id.title: Client Request Id
client_request_id.description: Generated by the client once per form; a replay returns the same alert.

AlertUpdate.title: AlertUpdate
AlertUpdate.description: Edit a DRAFT/READY alert and/or move it along DRAFT → READY → ISSUED.

NotificationAttemptOut.title: NotificationAttemptOut
NotificationAttemptOut.description: One dispatch attempt from the audit trail (Part 09 §6).
